# RoyalDent

> RoyalDent is a multilingual dental clinic in Jūrmala, Latvia. The website provides information about dental services, doctors, prices, patient preparation, clinic contacts, and appointment requests in Latvian, Russian, and English.

The clinic is located at Rīgas iela 20, Jūrmala, Latvia. This file is a navigation summary for language models and automated agents; medical decisions must always be made with a qualified clinician.

## Main pages

- [Latvian home](https://royaldent.lv/): Main information about the clinic and its services.
- [Services](https://royaldent.lv/services): Dental services provided by RoyalDent.
- [Doctors](https://royaldent.lv/doctors): RoyalDent medical team and professional profiles.
- [Prices](https://royaldent.lv/prices): Current dental service prices.
- [Patient information](https://royaldent.lv/patients): Booking, clinic rules, and preparation for diagnostics.
- [About the clinic](https://royaldent.lv/about): Clinic, technologies, location, and contact information.

## Key treatments

- [Dental implants](https://royaldent.lv/services/implants): Implant treatment information and cost calculator.
- [Microscope-assisted dentistry](https://royaldent.lv/services/microscope): Root canal and microscope-assisted treatment.
- [Dental prosthetics](https://royaldent.lv/services/prosthetics): Crowns, bridges, and prosthetic treatment.
- [Professional dental hygiene](https://royaldent.lv/services/hygiene): Professional oral hygiene services.
- [Teeth whitening](https://royaldent.lv/services/whitening): Professional whitening procedures.
- [Children's dentistry](https://royaldent.lv/services/kids): Dental care for children.
- [Aligners](https://royaldent.lv/services/aligners): Orthodontic treatment with clear aligners.

## Languages

- [Latviešu](https://royaldent.lv/): Latvian version and default language.
- [Русский](https://royaldent.lv/ru/): Russian version.
- [English](https://royaldent.lv/en/): English version.

- [Privacy policy](https://royaldent.lv/privacy): Personal data processing information.
